units.rawText: You want to know why I'm being so sentimental about the Oasis? Hm... Well, I guess it won't hurt to tell you. You've seen my case files before, right?

units.rawText: Yup, I'm a delinquent who disobeys orders. Well? Regret taking me in now?

units.rawText: Meh, you weren't scared at all. Yes, I disobeyed orders and ended up being grounded by my original team, then they kicked me over to another team before finally getting dumped in Project Neural Cloud. Makes me sound like the unpopular kid that nobody likes, right?

units.rawText: Humph... I'll tell you, they're all a bunch of stubborn blockheads who'd gladly let people die for the sake of palming responsibility off onto someone else or because they're playing petty politics.

units.rawText: Anyone with an ounce of justice in their hearts would disobey the orders they gave! I just... I just... I just didn't want to see lives lost because of reasons like that.
